thread:
deploy-bot: starting canary rollout release v0.9.14 -> edge-pool eu-west2 (10% traffic). tag: roll/edge-2026-03-15

incident-bot: alert detected — route `/generate` (canary) 5xx spike: 6.2% (baseline ~0.4%). threshold breached. Triggering PagerDuty.

pd-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-20260315-1 created and paged to `@omar` (level: critical). Link: https://pdb/redwood/INC-20260315-1

omar: ack INC-20260315-1 — I'm oncall. Pulling logs + checking deploy diff.

maria: on it too, watching telemetry. Can you paste the canary rollout manifest?

omar: paste of relevant snippet:
```
# deployment: edge-infer-canary
image: ghcr/redwood/infer:v0.9.14
traffic: 10%
env: KVCACHE=true, KVCACHE_TTL=300
```

chris: tailing pods, seeing repeated `kvcache: invalidation` logs + a few `kv_lookup: missing entry` spikes. Also p95 latency on canary pods up ~200ms.

jess: any customer-facing errors? ops-telemetry shows increased retry errors from a small set of tenants. Roughly ~2% of total requests hit errors and get retried; there are some client timeouts.

incident-bot: adding incident note: suspect interaction between KVCACHE and new runtime kernel flags (applied in v0.9.14).

arvind: I see a config diff — we toggled `KVCACHE_TTL` and bumped worker-concurrency. Could be a race that causes invalidations.

jess: mitigation options: 1) divert canary traffic to previous model v0.9.13, 2) roll back canary, 3) adjust cache TTL. Quickest = divert.

oncall-sre: +1 to divert. If divert doesn't reduce 5xx quickly, we'll roll back.

maria: preparing traffic diversion rule. Will switch canary target to `v0.9.13-fallback` within 30s. Applying now.

maria: `kubectl patch svc edge-gen --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/traffic/canary","value":"v0.9.13-fallback"}]'`

deploy-bot: canary traffic reroute applied to 0.9.13-fallback.

incident-bot: telemetry update (t+45s): 5xx rate decreased to 1.1% on the canary path. p95 latency trending down.

omar: good signal. I'm going to keep the PD incident open until 15m stable. tagging this for postmortem.

pd-bot: escalation policy check: next escalation would notify `@maria` (level 2) if no progress in 5m. (Already acknowledged by maria).

chris: checking pod logs for 0.9.14 to capture a root cause sample before pods are terminated. grabbing `grep -n \"invalidat\"` across logs.

chris: found repeated pattern where `kv_invalidate` is called shortly after `worker_restart` — suggests warmup <-> cache eviction race. snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T10:02:32Z] kv_invalidate: key=abc123
[2026-03-15T10:02:33Z] worker_restart: id=42 reason=OOM_SAFE
[2026-03-15T10:02:33Z] kv_lookup: miss key=abc123
```

jess: customer impact summary for ENG/CS: ~2% requests affected across eu-west2 canary users; retries caused transient increased latency for a subset of API customers, no data loss. Recommend proactive customer comms only if incident extends beyond 60m.

arvind: recording config diff + logs in incident timeline. Put a TODO to add a safety flag to disable kv-cache on canary runs.

maria: after diversion, I'm going to scale canary garden replicas `+2` to help drain any in-flight requests on older pods.

maria: `kubectl scale deployment edge-infer-canary --replicas=4` -> scaled.

incident-bot: note: automatic retries from gateway may have amplified client-side timeouts; reduced canary traffic mitigated amplification.

oncall-sre: since diversion worked and errors dropped under 1%, I'm going to mark this as mitigated. We'll keep canary frozen and hold rollout until root cause triaged and a fix is staged.

omar: leaving the incident in Acknowledged state. Will hand off to `@chris` (day-shift) for 8:00 follow-up and RCA ownership.

pd-bot: INC-20260315-1 status changed to `resolved` by `omar` after mitigation confirmation (stability window 10m). Resolution note: canary traffic diverted to safe image v0.9.13-fallback; suspected kv-cache invalidation in v0.9.14.

chris: ack handoff. I'll take the RCA and follow up with a postmortem. Immediate next steps: reproduce locally with KVCACHE_TTL=300 + worker-concurrency bump, add stricter cache locks, add canary safety flag.

arvind: created task TIM-9876: `investigate kvcache invalidation on v0.9.14 canary` and linked logs.

jess: filing ops note for customer success: `CS-brief: transient errors for small % of requests, mitigation applied, no further action unless incident reopens` :thumbsup:

oncall-sre: handing off final watch to night on-call `@maria` in 30m. leaving watchlist and Slack alert subscription.

maria: ack handoff. If any reappearance -> escalate back to oncall + PD.

incident-bot: timeline appended. Incident thread closed for now.

omar: thanks team. We'll formalize RCA and schedule a patch window for v0.9.14 revert or kvcache fix.

chris: noted. I'll post a short postmortem draft by EOD.

jess: closing loop with product/CS after postmortem.
